reading.zh: 从左到右：先搭环境 → 烧录固件 → HIL 冒烟（上机前的离线链路自检）→ 数据与体检工具 → 最后一段是发布链（清单生成 → 三个校验器 → 权重拉取/部署闸门）；kimi-relay 是与流程无关的旁路工具。
reading.en: Left to right: set the environment up, flash the board, run the HIL smoke check (offline link self-test before hardware), then the data and diagnostic utilities; the tail of the chain is release (manifest generation, the three verifiers, weight fetch and the deployment gate). kimi-relay is a side utility unrelated to the flow.
